pages.text: Use the Yeta Wrench on a machine face to cycle that face’s IO mode.
Hold the Conduit Probe in your main hand. Sneak and scroll until its tooltip says Copy/Paste. Sneak-use a configured conduit endpoint to copy, then use a matching endpoint to paste the settings.

Copy uses the conduit types present on the source face. Put the same tiers at the destination before pasting. Install filter items separately. Hold a spare conduit in your offhand to hide facades while using the probe.
